in_sanskrit.name: Shaambh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Fortune
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Shaambh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Shaambh is derived from the Sanskrit word Sham, which means 'God of Fortune'. In Hindu mythology, Shaambh is an aspect of Lord Shiva, who represents wealth, prosperity, and abundance. The name is also associated with courage, strength, and loyalty.
